integrity: Proof by exact stationary density, limiting integrals, and Taylor expansions; reproducibility checker included, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Stationary mean-field low-diffusivity branch only; no nonlinear branch stability, global uniqueness, finite-population dynamics or zero-bias branch selection. The source paper gives the exact stationary model and diffusion scaling; the new result is its previously unarticulated uniform limiting law and response phase portrait.
title: Uniform stationary weak-field law and a sharp response crossover for threshold resetting
